scope: Oracle semantics fixed before automatic interpretation; all examples synthetic

contract.available_time: First instant this version is available to the analyst
contract.decision_eligibility: available_time strictly less than decision_time; ties excluded
contract.revision_selection: Latest available version within record identity; different record IDs remain separate events
contract.stock: Last eligible level at declared instant
contract.flow: Sum eligible increments with event times in declared half-open interval
contract.entity: Account, customer and household are distinct units; crosswalk versions carry their own availability clocks
contract.currency: Declared currency per monetary field; aggregation across currency requires an explicit conversion rule

deliberate_ambiguities: An unlabeled timestamp pair can denote event/availability clocks or two process milestones; preserve alternatives if constraints cannot distinguish them.
Two same-name customers may be one household or distinct households; names alone cannot settle the unit.
An unlabeled amount can be an end-of-period stock or an interval flow; numerical type alone is insufficient.
